messages:
Mira (Growth PM): Quick heads-up — we'll run a 2-week live experiment on the pricing page next Tue. Goal: measure funnel lift from a compact calculator + inline FAQ vs the expanded tier explainer + commitment slider. Need final copy and routing.
Sam (UX): Sounds good. Which KPI do we prioritize? CTR to signup or qualified leads (MQLs)?
Mira (Growth PM): Prioritize MQLs first (want signal for sales handoff), but also track page CTR and time-on-page as secondary. Jordan, can you confirm inbound routing for the slider variant if someone indicates >50k commit?
Jordan (RevOps): Yep — any lead with slider >=50k will tag as 'high-commit' and route to AE queue. Also set UTM param: utm_pricing_expt=slider_highcommit.
Elaine (Content): Working on two FAQ variants: short inline answers (for compact calc) and an expanded accordion for tier explainer. I'll push copy by EOD today. Quick ask: include a one-liner addressing quantization/latency tradeoffs? It's come up a lot in benchmarks.
Sam (UX): Yes please — one microcopy line under "Performance & Cost". Keep it <= 12 words.
Alex (Analytics): Tracking plan: GA event "pricing_calc_submit", attribute experiment variant via cookie. Will create BigQuery view for MQL conversion + median session time. Also adding a micro funnel for 'faq open' events.
Mira (Growth PM): Perfect. Elaine, draft examples for both microcopy options and the CTA text. For slider: CTA = "Request dedicated pricing"; for compact calc CTA = "Estimate costs". Any objections?
Sam (UX): Fine. UX note: compact calc needs keyboard access and readable labels for accessibility — I'll add aria-labels and a focus state.
Jordan (RevOps): Routing detail: for compact calc leads — if estimated monthly >$10k, route to SDR queue; otherwise, self-serve sequence. I'll add an automation rule in HubSpot.
Elaine (Content): Draft FAQ snippets:
- Compact: "How do I estimate cost?" — "Enter tokens, concurrency, and we’ll show a monthly estimate. Use the slider for reserved commits." 
- Expanded: "Why choose Dedicated vs Hosted?" — "Dedicated provides predictable throughput & isolation; Hosted is quick to start and low-friction for devs." 
Also wrote the microcopy for perf/cost: "Lower precision quantization reduces cost with small latency trade-offs." Thoughts?
Mira (Growth PM): Love the FAQ language. For the microcopy line — tighten to: "Quantization lowers cost with minor latency impact." 10 words.
Alex (Analytics): Deploy checklist: experiment flag, variant cookie, events instrumented, GTM snippet, BI view. ETA: I can finish instrumentation tomorrow morning.
launch-bot: Experiment flag created: pricing_exp_2026_03_25. Canary deploy scheduled: 2026-03-25T08:00Z. Link: https://deploys.internal/redwood/pricing-expt/2812345678
Sam (UX): One more UX ask — show a subtle benchmark callout under the calculator for variant B: "Benchmarks: median p95 latency 80ms on Dedicated (n=500)." Use smaller font.
Mira (Growth PM): Good call. Elaine — please craft the microbenchmark blurb, avoid exact model names.
Elaine (Content): Blurb: "Typical latency (p95): ~80ms on Dedicated for common prompts." Short and non-technical.
Jordan (RevOps): I've added routing rules and an internal note for AE handoffs. Also creating a canned reply template for high-commit leads.
Mira (Growth PM): Action items:
- Elaine: finalize both FAQ sets + microcopy (today)
- Sam: accessibility + benchmark callout styling (tomorrow)
- Alex: instrument events and BI view (tomorrow AM)
- Jordan: confirm HubSpot workflows and canned reply (tomorrow)
I'll run a quick sync at 9:30am the day of deploy. If anything blocks, ping me here.
Sam (UX): Copy that. Will also prepare screenshots for the release notes.
Alex (Analytics): Once events are live I’ll smoke-test with a staging submit. Will post the test query link.
Mira (Growth PM): Thanks everyone :rocket: — excited to see whether the compact calculator reduces friction or the slider improves lead quality. We'll compare cohorts after 2 weeks and present results at the March marketing review.
Jordan (RevOps): Noted. I’ll flag any early high-value leads to Customer Success.
launch-bot: Canary deploy succeeded: pricing-expt v1 rolled to 5% traffic. Monitoring logs -> https://monitoring.internal/pricing-expt/2812345678
Mira (Growth PM): Great. If you see any spike in errors or tracking gaps, @Alex and @Sam are primary. Otherwise let's let it run.
